show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: After being heartlessly discarded by her tech-CEO husband on their anniversary, a seemingly ordinary assistant reveals her secret identity as the legendary hacker "Doctor Nova" to reclaim her power. Joining forces with her ex’s greatest rival in a high-stakes contract marriage, she orchestrates a brilliant corporate revenge to dismantle her former husband's empire and find true respect.
